headline: Steelworkers at Highland Valley Copper Issue Strike Notice
summary: United Steelworkers union Local 7619 issued a 72-hour strike notice to Teck’s Highland Valley Copper operation in British Columbia.
why: Labor disputes at major mining operations can disrupt metal supply chains and cause temporary volatility in commodity prices.

impacts.name: Teck Resources
impacts.why: Labor disputes and strike notices threaten to disrupt metal supply chains and operations.
